market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at $2,277 (Apr 28). 2026 YTD low was ~$1,746-$1,760. To hit $1,500 needs another ~14% below YTD low or ~34% drop from spot. ETH is extremely weak (down 54% from Oct 2025 peak of $4,946) with persistent insider selling and weak ETF flows. Plausible but not most-likely outcome over 8 months.
